# COSCUP 2023: Ubuntu Taiwan LoCo + UbuCon Asia booth

I plan to setup a joint Ubuntu Taiwan LoCo + UbuCon Asia booth on COSCUP 2023 to promote both Ubuntu TW folks and UbuCon Asia this year.
The plan is to basically share Taiwan LoCo’s booth with UbuCon Asia organizer folks. (single table with 2 chairs for both Ubuntu TW + UbuCon Asia)
But, depending on number of folks joining as booth staff, We might need apply for another table for larger booth.

So far, me([@sukso96100](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/sukso96100)), [@rjhsiao](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/rjhsiao) (TW LoCo), [@fenris](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/fenris), [@masafumiohta](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/masafumiohta) will join for the booth. [@isatrio](https://discourse.ubuntu.com/u/isatrio) might join, but not sure at the moment.

If you are coming to COSCUP (in Taipei) this year, and willing to join our booth to volunteer(+also interested to contribute to UbuCon Asia - as organizer, speaker or whatever), please feel free to reply to this thread or drop me a message! - email is also good

- COSCUP CFP [https://pretalx.coscup.org/coscup-2023-call-for-participation/](https://pretalx.coscup.org/coscup-2023-call-for-participation/)
- COSCUP 2023 website [https://coscup.org/2023/en/landing](https://coscup.org/2023/en/landing)

### [Ubuntu @ COSCUP 2023](https://events.canonical.com/event/29/)
